## Status and scope

**Decision state:** Needs discussion / decided / experimental / rejected / shipped

**Target environment:** testing / main / both

**Priority:** P0 / P1 / P2

**Parent / related issues:** #57

**Depends on:** Issue links (or none)

## Problem and intended behavior

Describe the actual behavior to change and why. Distinguish a proposed
physical law from a production change.

## Decisions still open

- [ ] Confirm what must be decided before implementation.

## Bounded acceptance

- [ ] Specify a physically motivated outcome and a reproducible measurement.
- [ ] Preserve relevant saved-world, Worker, and energy-economy behavior.
- [ ] Run appropriate fast tests/build/Worker and focused comparisons.
- [ ] Disclose material behavior changes before production promotion.
